observations: Single blue-painted industrial gearbox unit shown, sitting on dirt ground.
A small metal nameplate is visible on top of the housing but text is too small/blurred to read.
An output shaft protrudes from the right side, metal, no visible rust but no close-up detail.
No electric motor is visible anywhere in the photo, only the gearbox housing.
A black cable is seen on the ground near the unit but it is not clearly connected to anything.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'CHIDONBEST INDUSTRIAL' overlay the image; these are platform/seller marks, not proof of condition.
No tools, meter, or video showing the unit running are present.

claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp, ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the gearbox; no electric motor is visible, and the nameplate with ratio/power rating cannot be read.
No shipping label, import document, or country marking visible in photo 0.
No video or audio clip of the unit running; static photo only.
Requires an audio/video clip of operation; none provided.
No odometer or usage log concept applies to industrial gear units; no supporting documentation shown.
Housing bolts and seals are not shown in close-up to check for tamper marks.

risks.risk: Electric motor may not match claimed 20hp or may be missing entirely from the actual sale item.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the motor attached to the gearbox, including its nameplate showing hp/kW rating.
risks.if_unproven: priced as gearbox only, motor excluded

risks.risk: Gear ratio and manufacturer cannot be confirmed from the blurred nameplate.
risks.proof: A sharp close-up photo of the nameplate text.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded industrial gearbox of unknown ratio

risks.risk: Internal wear, gear knock, or bearing failure not visible in a static photo.
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit running under load, showing shaft rotation and audible sound.

risks.risk: Oil seal leaks or low lubricant level, common in used industrial gearboxes.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and seal areas, and oil level sight glass if present.

risks.risk: Shaft wear or misalignment affecting usable life.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the shaft surface and a video showing it spinning without wobble.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate showing brand, model, ratio, and torque rating.
Photo of the electric motor (separately or attached) with its own nameplate showing hp/kW.
Video clip of the gearbox and motor running together, audible, under some load.
Photos of the housing seals, oil sight glass, and underside for leaks.
Any import/purchase documentation showing origin as claimed.
response.reason: The claimed electric motor is not shown in any photo and the nameplate that would fix the gearbox's exact spec is unreadable, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without these missing shots.
